title: Northgate Card Account Opening Standard: One Account per Customer Profile
content:
**Standard.** A customer profile may hold one **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account at a time — at most 1 account per customer profile. A consumer profile holds a consumer tier and a business profile holds a business tier.

**When a new application is accepted.** A new application is accepted only when the customer has no other card account in applied, active or suspended status. The test is made on the system record of the customer's card accounts before the application is recorded; what the customer says about an account does not replace that record.

**Tier moves.** Moving between tiers of the same customer type is a product change on the existing account, never a second account.

**Accounts that do not count.** Closed, charged-off and declined accounts do not count.

| Status of the customer's other card account | Does it stand in the way of a new application? |
|---|---|
| applied | yes |
| active | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| closed | no |
| charged off | no |
| declined | no |
| no other card account | no |

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A consumer whose earlier Northgate Store Card account was closed applies for a Northgate Mastercard: the closed account does not count, so the single-account standard does not stand in the way.
- A consumer whose Northgate Secured Card is suspended applies for a Northgate Store Card: the suspended account counts, so a new application is not accepted; moving from the Northgate Secured Card to another consumer tier is a product change on the existing account.
